[RB-FIBER-CUT#03] Fiber cut on a transport link > Differential diagnosis: ... The alarms are identical: `LINK_LOS` plus `SITE_DOWN`. ... Versus a site power failure A power failure hits one site, never its siblings. It starts with `MAINS_FAILURE` hours before the site goes down and has no `LINK_LOS`. ... `LINK_LOS` with availability at zero is a hard failure. ... A single-site event cannot take down its siblings, and the `LINK_LOS` already explains the timing. ...
[RB-FIBER-CUT#01] Fiber cut on a transport link > Overview: A transport link (node type `transport_link`, id like `LNK-XXX-NN-A`) carries all the traffic of the sites behind it, usually three to five. When the fiber is cut, or the optic or port on the link fails, every one of those sites loses its backhaul at the same moment. The sites themselves are healthy. ... Repairs take from about two hours to most of a working day.
[RB-ALARM-REFERENCE#02] Alarm reference > Transport alarms: `LINK_LOS` (critical, on a transport link). Loss of signal: no light or no carrier on the uplink. All sites behind the link go down. Strong evidence of a cut or a planned splice. See the fiber cut and maintenance runbooks. `LINK_DEGRADED` (major or minor, on a link). ... On a fiber link a minor alarm with falling optical power can precede a cut.
[RB-FIBER-CUT#05] Fiber cut on a transport link > Verification steps: 1. `get_alarms` for the two hours around the first drop: find `LINK_LOS` on a link and list the `SITE_DOWN` sites. 2. `get_topology` for that link: confirm the `SITE_DOWN` set equals the children of the link, no more and no fewer. 3. `query_kpis` on availability for those sites: confirm they fall in the same step, and that a sibling link's sites do not. 4. ... 5. ... 6. ...

result.markdown:
# Transport Failure Impacting S-TUN-008 Availability

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-02-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence (LINK_LOS) on the transport link matches the exact timing of the site outages. Maintenance and changes were checked and ruled out. External events were not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-25 14:01 to 2026-09-25 21:13
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-25 14:00
- **Affected:** S-TUN-008, S-TUN-016, S-TUN-017

## Summary

A transport link failure (LINK_LOS) on LNK-TUN-02-B disrupted connectivity for S-TUN-008 and its sibling sites.

Availability for S-TUN-008 fell to zero starting on 2026-09-25 14:01 due to a transport failure and recovered at 2026-09-25 21:13 when the link cleared.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-25 14:00: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on transport link LNK-TUN-02-B. [ALM-000550, T6]
- 2026-09-25 14:01: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-008. [ALM-000551, T6]
- 2026-09-25 14:01: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on sibling sites S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-017. [ALM-000552, ALM-000553, T6]
- 2026-09-25 21:11: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-TUN-02-B. [ALM-000550, T6]
- 2026-09-25 21:13: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-TUN-008 and availability recovered. [ALM-000551, T6]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-008 experienced an availability drop to zero alongside drops in active users and download volume. [ANM-000380, ANM-000381, ANM-000382, T1]
- S-TUN-008 depends on transport link LNK-TUN-02-B, aggregation router AGG-TUN-02, and core upf CORE-UPF-01. [T2, S-TUN-008]
- A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-TUN-02-B simultaneously with SITE_DOWN alarms on S-TUN-008 and its siblings S-TUN-016 and S-TUN-017. [ALM-000550, ALM-000551, ALM-000552, ALM-000553, T6]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-TUN-008, LNK-TUN-02-B, or its parents during the incident window. [T4]
- No configuration changes were made on S-TUN-008, LNK-TUN-02-B, AGG-TUN-02, or its parents during the incident window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-02-B: confirmed. Direct evidence of LINK_LOS on the transport link which carries traffic for S-TUN-008 and its siblings, accompanied by simultaneous SITE_DOWN alarms without any concurrent maintenance or changes. [ALM-000550, ALM-000551, T4, T5, T6, RB-FIBER-CUT#01]
2. **power_failure** at S-TUN-008: rejected. A power failure affects only a single site and starts with MAINS_FAILURE hours prior, whereas this event impacted multiple sibling sites simultaneously with a LINK_LOS alarm. [ALM-000550, ALM-000551, RB-FIBER-CUT#03]
3. **bad_change** at LNK-TUN-02-B: rejected. Change management check confirmed zero changes occurred on the node or its parents during the relevant timeframe. [T5]
4. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-TUN-02-B: rejected. Maintenance check confirmed no maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected links or parent nodes. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected link or its parents during the incident window.
- T5: No configuration changes were recorded on the nodes during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect transport link LNK-TUN-02-B fiber path for physical damage or degradation.
- Review optical power history on LNK-TUN-02-B to check for precursor attenuation drops.
